articles.title: Trump says renewed Iran strikes ‘highly unlikely’ if talks progress but warns he could still strike
articles.summary: President Donald Trump said he is "highly unlikely" to restart open war with Iran, but warned he could still strike the country as Washington tries to reach a deal with Tehran to end the conflict. The now more than eight-month-old war, which stoked inflation and sent oil prices surging, has seen repeated bursts of fighting separated by ceasefires and peace talks for months.
